title: TAI bootstrap preflight authority
objective: Keep the owner-authorized REG.RU preflight fail-closed and fully observable: accept only the exact safe four-blocker bootstrap state, cancel stale duplicate commands, and publish a target-bound commit status plus redacted issue evidence for every terminal outcome before protected activation may proceed.
boundaries: Bootstrap eligibility requires exactly API_WEB_NOT_EXACT_MAIN, TAI_SERVICE_NOT_MATERIALIZED, TAI_DEDICATED_ENV_NOT_MATERIALIZED and TAI_DEDICATED_DB_PRINCIPAL_NOT_ATTESTED
The existing API and Web runtime must be present, baseline-healthy and backed by an identified rollback baseline before bootstrap is eligible
Compose authority, protected topology, disk and memory capacity, private-model connectivity, TAI relations, knowledge, model profile, model identity and no-mutation checks must all be PASS
The existing protected activate action remains the only authority that may deploy exact API, Web and Migration images and then activate restricted Qwen
Any additional, missing-authority, malformed, unhealthy-baseline, capacity, model-connectivity or mutation-related blocker fails closed
A zero-blocker strict result still requires API_WEB_EXACT_MAIN and raw passed=true evidence
Post-activation and post-deployment acceptance must finish with a strict zero-blocker postflight or invoke the existing rollback path
The production self-hosted owner-preflight job contains shell steps only and performs no third-party Action download
Redacted preflight evidence is target-bound canonical JSON capped at 65536 bytes before crossing the job-output boundary
The newest exact owner command cancels stale queued or running preflight duplicates for issue 3365
Every owner command terminal path publishes TAI REG.RU Preflight commit status and a redacted issue comment, including upstream, contract and image-authority failures
Terminal evidence contains only exact target/current SHA, stage, blocker codes, job conclusions, no-mutation assertion and run URL
No inbound production SSH, direct runner Docker authority, new sudo capability, credential, hosting service or recurring expense is introduced
Model admission remains a separately reported maturity state and is never fabricated
